interpretation: This analysis will use all 500 included US App Store reviews (Aug 19, 2025 – Aug 15, 2026) to identify the most impactful problems and opportunities, with special attention to subscription value and workout usability. It will also detect features that receive sharply mixed sentiment — praised by some users and criticized by others — and will deliberately preserve these conflicting viewpoints rather than collapsing them into a single sentiment. The conclusions will be based only on the provided review statistics and the review texts implied by those counts; no external data or app-specific category labels are assumed.
explicitLimitations: Country/storefront is not provided in the statistics; 'US App Store' is inferred from the stated goal, not from the data.
Language distribution includes 'other' and 'und' categories, so non-English/undefined-language reviews cannot be individually identified or excluded from the analysis.
No app-specific review categories are predefined; themes must be derived from the review texts and cannot be enforced through filters.
Conflicting feedback is identified qualitatively from review text/tone; the available stats alone do not reveal within-feature sentiment polarity.
Version-level conclusions are limited to the versions present in the version distribution and are not statistically tested.

focusAreas.label: Subscription value: praise, complaints, and perceived worth
Workout usability: ease, friction, and feature-specific reactions
Most impactful problems: frequent or strongly negative themes
Opportunities: unmet needs, requests, and positive potential
Polarizing features: same feature loved by some, disliked by others
